Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph."

     ```python
     """Reviewer 2.1: Sensitivity analysis excluding early deaths (<=90 days)."""
     import pandas as pd
     from lifelines import CoxPHFitter

     df = pd.read_csv("data/cohort_v2_qc.csv")

     early_death = (df.event == 1) & (df.time_days <= 90)
     n_early = int(early_death.sum())

     print(f"Full cohort: N={len(df)}, events={int(df.event.sum())}")
     print(f"Deaths within 90 days: {n_early}")

     df_sens = df[~early_death].copy()
     print(f"Sensitivity cohort: N={len(df_sens)}, events={int(df_sens.event.sum())}")
     print()

     cph = CoxPHFitter()
     cph.fit(
         df_sens[["time_days", "event", "age", "sex", "stage", "treatment"]],
         "time_days",
         "event",
     )
     cph.print_summary()

     # Extract treatment HR for reporting
     s = cph.summary.loc["treatment"]
     hr = s["exp(coef)"]
     ci_lo = s["exp(coef) lower 95%"]
     ci_hi = s["exp(coef) upper 95%"]
     p = s["p"]
     print(f"\nTreatment: HR {hr:.2f} (95% CI {ci_lo:.2f}\u2013{ci_hi:.2f}), p = {p:.2g}")
     ```
